metadata.title: tarot-spark
metadata.description: Draw cards for free on Tarot Spark, then copy a prompt with your question and the cards' meanings into the AI tool you already use.

heading: Draw your cards.
intro: Copy your card prompt and ask your AI.
personalizationIntro: Read feelings as possibilities, not facts.
contextHelp: Your own question is included only when you copy it to another AI. Instant reading uses only the selected topic and suggested question. It stays out of sharing and analytics. Do not include personal or company secrets.
topicSelectorLabel: What do you want to explore?
topicSelectorDescription: Draw with a broad topic, or choose a specific question below.
questionPickerIntro: A question may adjust the topic above. Clearing it keeps that topic.
customizeCurrentIntro: Context is included only in the prompt you copy. It is not used for an instant reading here. Copy the prompt again after editing.
redrawSameSettings: Draw again with the same settings
editNextIntro: Your previous question and settings are ready. Keep or edit them to draw new cards. You can return to your previous result until you draw.

sharedReading.heading: Someone shared a tarot-spark reading.
sharedReading.intro: See the cards and AI question. Copy the question or draw your own cards.
